scope: Project Blue Book CE1-CE5 encounter-class normalization
classification_policy: Highest applicable public encounter class wins. CE1-CE5 describes reported encounter content and does not assert that the report is true or unexplained. Project Blue Book source classifications are preserved separately in provenance.
multi_report_policy: Conservative primary-incident attribution: unrelated secondary clippings or reports inside a source file do not promote the primary incident to a higher CE class.
semantic_review: Reviewed positive CE2/CE3/CE5 anchors plus explicit false-positive and multi-report contamination traps before database rebuild.
